citation: Traits a public sees in an official from what they say and do on camera, in debates and in the news (owner, Oct 14, 2026: 'everyone knows he is loud and bombastic and selfish'; Sept 26 trait ruling for the trait names). A person's other traits stay internal and come out only through what they do in play.

reputationTraits.citation: How many of a figure's visible traits make up their public reputation: the ones furthest from the middle. Spread 2 to 5.

statedPositions.citation: How many of a figure's positions the public knows: their own causes first, then the questions they stand on most strongly. Spread 2 to 6.
